items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, that's uh, Rice Blair between Onzag and La Perouse... [INTERVIEWEE] He must've worked with some good bands. Ah, man. Well, I don't think he worked with too many bands.

ctx.x: Chani was there first on the boat? Yeah. And then who took Chani's place? Will's took his place? Yeah, Will's took his place. What's Will's full name? I don't know Will's full name. And this Reuben Oliver, what were you saying about him? Reuben Oliver, does he live near here or something? No, does he know what he's talking about?

Oh, that's uh, Rice Blair between Onzag and La Perouse. We'll have to look for him too. He's out of the... He waits for a sudden demolition. He's out of the trouble. He don't come here. Yeah, but he probably have some good memories. Oh, yeah. How old are you? How old are you? I'm eight, huh? I'm old at nine. I'm going to be married. What? You think he's older than you, Dick? Yeah, he's older than 50. I'm 55. Oh, yeah. He's older than 55. I'm close now. Over 50. I'm 55. I'm 56. I guess.

He must've worked with some good bands. Ah, man. Well, I don't think he worked with too many bands. Well, of course, what I mean, because I know that when he worked with Santa, they stayed on that boat that's so long, you know. I don't think that he worked around with too many bands. So, after they sold that boat, Ruby just give up all the music altogether and went with the Southern Riemont, you see? And he's still with them. Yes. Yes. That's what we're killing. So, how long did you stay with Piku? I stayed with…
